TASK: Rewrite `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/Size Chart & Recommender/app/routes/app.size-charts.$id.tsx` to use React Polaris components instead of `<s-*>` web components.

IMPORTANT: The app already has PolarisAppProvider set up in app.tsx. All React Polaris components are available.

This is a LARGE file (~1600 lines) with a complex chart editor. Read it carefully first.

MIGRATION RULES — Replace every `<s-*>` component:
- `<s-page heading="X">` → `<Page title="X" backAction={{ onAction: () => navigate("/app/size-charts") }}>`
- `<s-section heading="X">` → use `<BlockStack gap="600">` or `<Layout.Section>`
- `<s-box padding="base" borderWidth="base" borderRadius="base">` → `<Card>`
- `<s-box borderWidth="large">` → `<Card>` with a wrapper div: `<div style={{outline:"2px solid #005bd3", borderRadius:"12px"}}>`
- `<s-stack direction="block" gap="base">` → `<BlockStack gap="400">`
- `<s-stack direction="block" gap="small-200">` → `<BlockStack gap="200">`
- `<s-stack direction="inline" gap="base">` → `<InlineStack gap="400">`
- `<s-stack direction="inline" gap="small-200">` → `<InlineStack gap="200">`
- `<s-heading>` → `<Text as="h2" variant="headingMd" fontWeight="bold">`
- `<s-text>` → `<Text as="p" variant="bodyMd">`
- `<s-text color="subdued">` → `<Text as="p" variant="bodyMd" tone="subdued">`
- `<s-badge tone="X">Y</s-badge>` → `<Badge tone="X">Y</Badge>`
- `<s-button variant="primary">` → `<Button variant="primary">`
- `<s-button variant="tertiary">` → `<Button>` (secondary default) or `<Button variant="plain">`
- `<s-button tone="critical">` → `<Button tone="critical">`
- `<s-button href="X">` → `<Button url="X">`
- `<s-button loading={x}>` → `<Button loading={x}>`
- `<s-button slot="primary-action">` → Page `primaryAction` prop
- `<s-button slot="secondary-action">` → Page `secondaryActions` prop
- `<s-banner tone="X" heading="Y">` → `<Banner tone="X" title="Y">`
- `<s-divider />` → `<Divider />`
- `<s-text-field label="X" value={v} onChange={fn}>` → `<TextField label="X" value={v} onChange={fn} autoComplete="off" />`
- `<s-text-area>` → `<TextField multiline={6} />`
- `<s-select>` + `<s-option>` → `<Select label="X" options={[{label,value}]} value={v} onChange={fn} />`
- `<s-number-field label="X" value={String(n)} min={1} max={100} onChange={fn}>` → `<TextField label="X" type="number" value={String(n)} onChange={fn} min={1} max={100} autoComplete="off" />`
- `<s-switch checked={x} onChange={fn} />` → `<Checkbox checked={x} onChange={fn} label="Label" />`
- `<s-button-group>` → `<ButtonGroup>` or `<ButtonGroup variant="segmented">`
- `<s-unordered-list>` + `<s-list-item>` → `<List>` + `<List.Item>`
- `<s-clickable onClick={fn}>` → wrapper div with onClick
- `<s-link href="X">Y</s-link>` → `<Button variant="plain" url="X">Y</Button>`

IMPORTANT React Polaris event handlers:
- `<TextField onChange>` receives value string directly: `onChange={(value) => setValue(value)}`
- `<Select onChange>` receives value string directly: `onChange={(value) => setValue(value)}`
- `<Checkbox onChange>` receives boolean: `onChange={(checked) => setChecked(checked)}`
- NO `(e: Event) => (e.target as HTMLInputElement).value` pattern

For TAB NAVIGATION (the 5 tabs: Chart, Assignments, Position, Recommendation, Settings):
Use `<ButtonGroup variant="segmented">`:
```tsx
<ButtonGroup variant="segmented">
  {tabs.map((tab) => (
    <Button key={tab.key} pressed={activeTab === tab.key} onClick={() => setActiveTab(tab.key)}>
      {tab.label}
    </Button>
  ))}
</ButtonGroup>
```

For the TABLE EDITOR component: KEEP all native HTML `<table>`, `<tr>`, `<td>`, `<input>` with inline styles — there is no Polaris table editor equivalent. This is an interactive spreadsheet-like editor.

For the CHART PREVIEW component: KEEP all custom inline styles — it's a visual widget mockup.

For radio-selection cards (button position, country targeting): use Card with onClick and outline for selected state.

For responsive grids: `<InlineGrid columns={{ xs: 1, sm: 2, md: 3 }} gap="400">`

IMPORTS:
```typescript
import { useNavigate } from "react-router";
import {
  Page, Layout, Card, BlockStack, InlineStack, Text, Badge, Button,
  ButtonGroup, Banner, Box, Divider, InlineGrid, TextField, Select,
  Checkbox, List, Icon,
} from "@shopify/polaris";
import { CheckCircleIcon } from "@shopify/polaris-icons";
```

KEEP: All loader/action logic, types, interfaces (ChartData, DisplaySettings, Assignment), parseChartData, formatDate, TableEditor component internals, ChartPreview component. Only rewrite the main component's JSX and sub-component JSX that uses `<s-*>` elements.

Read the FULL file first. Then rewrite. The file should have ZERO `<s-` elements when done (except inside TableEditor and ChartPreview which use native HTML). Verify by searching.
